summary: Conservation/LULUCF is anchored by Belgium's listed national figure of -320 Kt CO2eq in the 2030 framework, while the document also reports a collective EU carbon-sinks target of -310 Mt CO2-eq by 2030 (elsewhere expressed as 310 Mt of net removals). Restoration provisions call for measures on at least 20% of EU land and sea areas by 2030 and for all ecosystems needing restoration by 2050; peatland and wetland rewetting has a reported mitigation potential of 51–54 MtCO2-eq/yr. The mixed reforestation measure, respecting biodiversity and sustainable forest management, has a reported mitigation potential of 8–235 MtCO2-eq/yr. Agriculture focuses on fertiliser-use efficiency, linked to 19 MtCO2-eq/yr. Except for Belgium's -320 figure, these figures are EU-wide, not Belgian allocations. Belgium's land cover is 50.8% agriculture, 22.0% forest, 15.4% grassland and 0.3% wetland, so no Belgian area share for the collective measures is supplied.
